verdict.rationale: Speechmatics' own diarization docs say it separates a transcript into distinct speakers or channels so you can see who said what, which is the core outcome of the story. The evidence is a single summary line. It does not show how a developer requests diarization (no config parameter or API field), and it does not show how speaker labels appear in the transcript output. missing for 10: documented request parameter or config for enabling diarization, the speaker-label output format in the transcript, coverage across batch and realtime modes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what

citations.quote: Use Speechmatics' Diarization to separate a transcript into distinct speakers or channels, so you can clearly see who said what.
